Introduction This paper describes a new version of the package feyn.gle [1] written in the language GLE. Programs for drawing Feynman diagrams can be subdivided into script-based ones and GUI-based ones. In the case of a script-based program, a user has to write a script in some language to draw a diagram. This approach has some advantages: it is easy to copy a script from some earlier work and re-use it for a new work, maybe, with some adjustments; it is easy to have a set of diagrams in exactly the same style: same dimensions, identical subdiagrams, etc.; script texts can be automatically generated by some programs. Email address: A.G.Grozin@inp.nsk.su (Andrey Grozin) There are several programs where diagram scripts are written directly inside a L A TEX file.
